analysis.session_summary: The tape was a broad USD rally: DXY/USD closed up 53.6 points (+0.534%) at 100.866, near the top of its 73.6-point range, while SPX fell -61.7 and VIX rose +27.5 points to 17.66. The largest measured impulse came from the US business growth headline, but it only accounted for 16-25% of key USD legs. EUR/USD closed -58.9 pips at 1.13782, near the session low, and EUR/GBP rose 18.6 pips. European PMI beats were polarity-muted and did not offset the dollar/risk-off tone.

themes.evidence: USD mean_vs_majors +0.666%; DXY/USD closed up 53.6 points at 100.866, near top of 73.6 range; SPX down -61.7 to 7705.3; VIX up +27.5 to 17.66.
US business growth surge contributed -11.7 pips (16%) to EUR/USD down leg, +26.0 pips (25%) to USD/JPY up leg, and -11.8 pips (18%) to NZD/USD down leg.
German Services actual 52.9 vs forecast 49.9; French Services actual 51.4 vs forecast 48.3; UK Manufacturing actual 52.0 vs forecast 51.5; all event polarities muted inside noise floor.
Brent/USD closed +2.153% at 104.664, recovering from a -329.3 leg with a +577.5 leg; Trump/Rubio/Iran official headlines.

leg_notes.EUR/USD: An early 19.0-pip bid faded into a -74.2-pip slide that took the pair to 1.13782, near the bottom of the 78.9-pip daily range, with the US business-growth impulse contributing only -11.7 pips (16% of that leg).

polarity_reads.read: Actual 52.9 vs forecast 49.9, but the EUR basket moved only -0.007%, inside the noise floor; this muted reaction suggests the market is not positioned to reward European activity beats while the USD and risk-off tone dominate.

Actual 51.4 vs forecast 48.3, with the own-currency basket impulse at +0.015%, inside the noise floor; the beat failed to lift EUR, indicating EUR upside is gated by USD/risk sentiment rather than European data.
Actual 52.0 vs forecast 51.5, but GBP basket moved only -0.021%, inside the noise floor; the small positive surprise produced no bid in GBP, consistent with GBP mean -0.174% on the day.

scenarios.name: USD bid extends on US exceptionalism and risk-off
scenarios.thesis: DXY closed at 100.866 near the top of a 73.6-point range and VIX at 17.66 near its high, while US business growth impulse was only partial; continuation favors USD against high-beta and commodity FX.
scenarios.invalidation: A reversal below EUR/USD 1.13782 with a break back above 1.14 stalls the USD bid.
